name: Voice Pill
description: A voice-recording button that opens like a messaging app: you hold it, it shows a waveform, and you slide aside to cancel.
interactionNotes: Hold the button to start recording; the timer and waveform open right there. If you drag your finger toward cancel, the color and text warn you, and releasing in that state cancels the recording instead of sending it. With a keyboard, Space starts and Escape cancels.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: Accent color of the recording state.

props.name: iconColor
props.description: Color of the microphone icon at rest.

props.name: background
props.description: Background color of the pill.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the button in the closed state, in pixels.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape when open: pill or rounded.

props.name: reach
props.description: How far the pill opens ahead of the button.

props.name: showTime
props.description: Show the recording time.

props.name: waveform
props.description: Show the waveform.

props.name: slideToCancel
props.description: Cancel by sliding aside.

props.name: cancelDistance
props.description: How far you have to drag to cancel.

props.name: attack
props.description: How fast the wave reacts to louder sound, in milliseconds.

props.name: release
props.description: How fast the wave returns, in milliseconds.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: Waveform sensitivity.

props.name: floor
props.description: The minimum height the wave bars have.

props.name: openDuration
props.description: Opening duration, in milliseconds.

props.name: pressScale
props.description: Button scale while pressed.

props.name: mode
props.description: Whether it works by holding or by a single tap.

props.name: holdAfter
props.description: In auto mode, how long a hold means recording.

props.name: reactive
props.description: Where the wave comes from: simulated or a real microphone.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the button.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Screen reader label.

props.name: onStart
props.description: When recording starts.

props.name: onStop
props.description: When recording ends; the reason comes with it.

props.name: autoPreview
props.description: Automatic waveform preview without interaction; for a showcase card.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the root.

tips: mic mode needs a real microphone and the browser will ask for permission; for a demo, simulated mode is hassle-free.
For a button that starts with one tap and ends with another, use toggle mode.
If you turn off slide-to-cancel, the user can finish recording only by releasing.
